method: Exact import/executed-path analysis of the closure source delta against the accepted S14 composite binding (buildDigest 4c05da6e…) and the S13 F2-final binding (buildDigest 599ed363…). No path equivalence is asserted without naming the imported module and the executed lifecycle phase. Rows re-executed live on the closure candidate are CURRENT; rows whose accepted evidence binds an earlier build are STALE_REQUIRES_RERUN for a hypothetical S13 re-certification, with an explicit bounded-scope disposition recorded for this closure.
